name: com.andque/strata-b2a-mcp
title: STRATA & TrashPan B2A Public Data, 5.86M JP KYB, 44.2k Domains, EDINET, LEI, OFAC & Golf EV MCP
description: Zero-PII B2A MCP: 16 streams, 18 canonical tools (+126 aliases), 5.86M JP KYB, LEI, OFAC & Golf EV

tools.name: list_b2a_data_streams
tools.description: List all 16 STRATA/TrashPan B2A data streams, returning dataset scale, supported query modes, nationwide 47-prefecture coverage, per-stream pricing metadata, open-data rights registry, and canonical query_* tool mappings. Use `list_b2a_data_streams` to inspect available streams and schemas; use `probe_stream_inventory` to check record existence and SHA-256 freshness for free ($0) before calling a paid `query_*` tool.

category.description: Optional domain category filter to inspect specific stream schemas and capabilities.

includeLegacyAliases.description: When true, includes backward-compatible legacy tool aliases for each stream.

tools.name: probe_stream_inventory
tools.description: Pre-check target record existence (recordExists), 24-hour freshness, deterministic SHA-256 hash (currentHash), and Sigstore Rekor TAPP seal status across all 16 B2A streams (13-digit corporate numbers, domains, LEIs, OFAC wallets, ATS job boards, keywords, or golf courses). Use `list_b2a_data_streams` to inspect available streams and schemas; use `probe_stream_inventory` to check record existence and SHA-256 freshness for free ($0) before calling a paid `query_*` tool.

streamId.description: Target B2A stream ID to probe (e.g. domain-lookup, ats-jobs, google-trends, jp-company-kyb-registry-delta, ansr-golf-ev-engine, jp-places-poi-geospatial-intel, olipai-jp-tcg-collectibles-market, jp-academic-rnd-patent-citation-feed, jp-entity-reputation).

domain.description: Domain name to check when probing domain-lookup or jp-entity-reputation (e.g. "nttdata.com", "preferred.jp").

domains.description: Batch of corporate domains when probing domain-lookup (up to 5) or jp-entity-reputation.

boardSlug.description: Company ATS board slug when probing ats-jobs (e.g. "stripe", "layerx").

keyword.description: Search keyword when probing google-trends or Japanese public data streams.

mode.description: Mode when probing jp-entity-reputation ("lookup", "batch", "screen", "filter", "gleif_lei", "ofac_sanctions", "gov_qualification", or "edinet_gc_amendments") or ansr-golf-ev-engine ("ev", "sg", "dispersion", "strategy", "course_search", or "hole_strategy").

qualificationGrade.description: Exact Unified Government Qualification grade ("A", "B", "C", or "D") when probing mode="gov_qualification".

minQualificationGrade.description: Minimum Unified Government Qualification grade ("A" highest through "D").

companyScale.description: Company scale ("large", "sme", "micro", or "other") when probing mode="gov_qualification".

edinetCode.description: 6-character FSA EDINET submitter code (e.g. "E02144") when probing mode="edinet_gc_amendments" or jp-edinet-financial-macro-feed.

docId.description: 8-character EDINET filing document ID (e.g. "S100ABCD") when probing mode="edinet_gc_amendments".

goingConcernOnly.description: When true in mode="edinet_gc_amendments", probes filings with statutory Going Concern notes or material events.

amendmentsOnly.description: When true in mode="edinet_gc_amendments", probes amended securities/quarterly/semi-annual reports.

corporateNumber.description: 13-digit Japanese Corporate Number (NTA Mod-9 validated, e.g. "1180301018771") when probing jp-entity-reputation or KYB/tenders/patent streams.

corporateNumbers.description: Batch of 13-digit Japanese Corporate Numbers (1 to 1,000).

lei.description: 20-character ISO 17442 LEI (Mod 97-10 validated, e.g. "5493006W3QUS5LMH6R84") when probing jp-entity-reputation with mode="gleif_lei".

walletAddress.description: Blockchain wallet address (e.g. "0x...", "TNiq9AXBp9EjUqhDhrwrfvAA8U3GUQZH81") when probing jp-entity-reputation with mode="ofac_sanctions".

walletAddresses.description: Batch of blockchain wallet addresses for OFAC organizational sanctions screening.

entityName.description: Organization or corporate legal name when probing jp-entity-reputation with mode="ofac_sanctions".

entityNames.description: Batch of organization or corporate legal names when probing jp-entity-reputation with mode="ofac_sanctions".

assetSymbol.description: Optional digital currency ticker filter in mode="ofac_sanctions" across 600 organization-linked SDN wallets (e.g. "TRX", "ETH", "XBT", "USDT"). Free probes return dataset availability only.

includeWeakAliases.description: Optional flag for paid OFAC screening (weak AKAs excluded by default unless true; when true, weak AKAs are tagged with matchedVia="weak_aka_alias" and akaStrength="weak"). Free probes return dataset availability only.

strictExcludeUnobserved.description: In mode="screen" / "filter", controls unknown/unobserved handling for exclusion filters (excludeGoingConcern, excludeRecentEdinetAmendments, excludeLapsedLei). Defaults to false (retains unobserved corporations with unobservedOrExcludedScopes[] tags; when true, unobserved corporations are also excluded).

excludeGoingConcern.description: In mode="screen" / "filter", excludes corporations with active EDINET Going Concern notes or material events.

excludeRecentEdinetAmendments.description: In mode="screen" / "filter", excludes corporations that filed recent amended securities reports on EDINET.

requireGleifLei.description: In mode="screen" / "filter", requires the corporation to hold a registered GLEIF LEI.

excludeLapsedLei.description: In mode="screen" / "filter", excludes corporations whose GLEIF LEI status is LAPSED.

lapsedOnly.description: When true in mode="gleif_lei", filters for LAPSED LEI registrations.

hasBicOnly.description: When true in mode="gleif_lei", filters for entities with SWIFT BIC codes.

prefectureCode.description: 2-digit JIS prefecture code across all 47 Japanese prefectures ("01" to "47", e.g. "13" for Tokyo, "27" for Osaka).

prefecture.description: Japanese prefecture name or 2-digit JIS code across all 47 prefectures (e.g. "北海道", "東京都", "大阪府", "13").

query.description: Facility/station/golf-course query string when probing POI or ANSR golf streams.

holeNumber.description: Optional golf hole number (1-18) when probing ansr-golf-ev-engine.

secCode.description: 4- or 5-digit Japanese securities code when probing jp-edinet-financial-macro-feed or mode="edinet_gc_amendments".

limit.description: Optional row scan limit (free probes cap internal scan budget at 25 rows).

tools.name: query_domain_b2a_posture
tools.description: Query live DNS (A/AAAA/NS/MX/TXT), RDAP registration/expiry, SPF/DMARC score (0-100), HTTP TTFB, tech stack, /llms.txt, and B2A Readiness Tier for 1-5 web domains. Note: For 13-digit Japanese corporate registry & KYB lookup by domain, use query_jp_corporate_reputation_and_sanctions instead.

domains.description: List of 1 to 5 domain names to inspect per request (e.g. ["cloudflare.com", "andque.com"]). Requests with 6+ domains are rejected with HTTP 400.

includeEmailPosture.description: Include SPF/DMARC parsing and deliverability scoring ($0.008 event)

tools.name: query_ats_job_postings
tools.description: Query normalized job postings from official Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby career boards (boards / ats + boardSlug) with daily SHA-256 delta status (new, changed, removed, unchanged). Note: For Japanese corporate KYB verification of employers, use query_jp_corporate_reputation_and_sanctions instead.

boards.description: List of official ATS job boards to query and compute SHA-256 deltas for.

includeDescriptionText.description: When true, includes normalized plain-text job description excerpts.

includeDelta.description: When true, computes daily SHA-256 per-job delta status (new, changed, removed, unchanged).

onlyDeltaChanges.description: When true, filters output to only newly posted, modified, or removed openings.

maxJobsPerBoard.description: Maximum job postings returned per ATS board (1 to 500).

maxJobs.description: Maximum total job postings returned across the request (1 to 500).

since.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. "2026-11-22T00:00:00Z") to replay all job delta events (new/changed/removed) observed since that timestamp. Defaults to a 24-hour retention window so multiple customers receive identical daily deltas.

tools.name: query_google_search_trends
tools.description: Query real-time Google Autocomplete related search queries for seed keywords and Google Trends daily trending topics, approximate traffic, and news citations for any country (geo, e.g. "US", "JP"). Note: For domain technical posture or /llms.txt inspection, use query_domain_b2a_posture instead.

keywords.description: Keywords to query for related searches and daily trend matches (e.g. ["mcp server", "cloudflare"])

geo.description: 2-letter ISO country code for localized trends (e.g. "US", "JP", "GB").

includeRelatedQueries.description: When true, returns ranked Google Autocomplete related queries for each keyword.

includeTrendingNow.description: When true, includes Google Trends Daily RSS trending topics, traffic volume, and news links.

tools.name: query_jp_court_foreclosures
tools.description: Query Supreme Court BIT real estate foreclosure opening results (valuation, winning bid, multiple, bidder count, corporate/individual winner) and period notices across all 47 prefectures (prefecture), with J-SHIS seismic factors. Note: For general station/coordinate POI and elevation lookup, use query_jp_area_poi_and_seismic_hazard instead.

prefecture.description: Nationwide Japanese prefecture filter across all 47 prefectures (e.g. "北海道", "東京都", "大阪府", "福岡県").

municipality.description: Municipality or ward substring filter (e.g. "千代田区", "札幌市").

court.description: District court name filter (e.g. "東京地方裁判所", "大阪地方裁判所").

caseNumber.description: Court auction case number filter (e.g. "令和8年(ケ)").

propertyKind.description: Real estate property type ("all", "土地", "戸建", "区分所有", or "一棟").

stage.description: Auction stage filter: "opening_results" (winning bids & multiples), "period_announcements" (upcoming auctions), or "all".

minValuationYen.description: Minimum court appraisal valuation in JPY.

maxValuationYen.description: Maximum court appraisal valuation in JPY.

limit.description: Maximum auction records to return (1 to 200).

tools.name: query_jp_registry_and_recalls_delta
tools.description: Query daily Japan NTA corporate incorporations/relocations/closures, Qualified Invoice expirations, MHLW labor referrals, FSA warnings, and CAA product recalls across all 47 prefectures. Note: For deep per-company KYB, 5.85M registry lookup, Unified Qualification, LEI, or OFAC sanctions screening, use query_jp_corporate_reputation_and_sanctions instead.

category.description: Daily delta category filter across NTA registry changes, invoice expirations/registrations, MHLW labor referrals, FSA warnings, Kanpo notices, or CAA product recalls.

prefecture.description: Nationwide Japanese prefecture filter across all 47 prefectures (e.g. "東京都", "愛知県", "福岡県").

keyword.description: Company name, product name, or statutory event keyword filter.

limit.description: Maximum delta records to return (1 to 250).

tools.name: query_jp_giteki_and_procurement_tenders
tools.description: Query Japan MIC Giteki wireless/IoT device certifications, KKJ public procurement tenders, government contract awards, and J-Grants open subsidies (feedType) across all 47 prefectures. Note: For vendor A-D Unified Qualification grades, use query_jp_corporate_reputation_and_sanctions (mode="gov_qualification") instead.

feedType.description: Intelligence feed filter: "giteki_devices" (MIC wireless/IoT certifications), "public_tenders" (KKJ RFPs), "procurement_awards" (winning contracts), "subsidies" (J-Grants), or "all".

keyword.description: Device model, corporate applicant, ministry, or tender/subsidy keyword filter.

tools.name: query_cisa_kev_and_cloud_status
tools.description: Query U.S. CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) CVE catalog (ransomware campaign flags and remediation due dates) and real-time operational status across 7 core AI/cloud providers (feedType: all, cisa_kev, ai_cloud_status). Note: For per-domain DNS/SPF/DMARC/HTTPS posture checks, use query_domain_b2a_posture instead.

feedType.description: Feed filter: "cisa_kev" (exploited CVEs), "ai_cloud_status" (7 core AI/cloud providers), or "all".

ransomwareOnly.description: When true, returns only CISA KEV vulnerabilities confirmed in ransomware campaigns.

keyword.description: Vendor, product, vulnerability name, or cloud provider keyword filter.

limit.description: Maximum CVE/status records to return (1 to 200).

tools.name: query_jp_medical_facilities
tools.description: Query Japan MHLW Navii official directory of 7,715 hospitals and clinics across all 47 prefectures (prefCode "01".."47"), returning Japanese/English names, municipality codes, GPS coordinates, and URLs. Note: For multi-category radius POI and seismic hazard search, use query_jp_area_poi_and_seismic_hazard instead.

prefCode.description: 2-digit JIS Prefecture Code across all 47 Japanese prefectures ("01" Hokkaido through "47" Okinawa, e.g. "13" for Tokyo, "27" for Osaka).

keyword.description: Hospital/clinic official Japanese or English name keyword filter.

onlyWithWebsite.description: When true, returns only facilities with a published official website URL.

limit.description: Maximum medical facility records to return (1 to 250).

tools.name: query_jp_edinet_and_macro_feeds
tools.description: Query daily FSA EDINET securities/shareholding filings, MOF JGB yield curve (2Y/10Y/30Y) & FX macro rates, and Diet/e-Gov legislative feeds (feedType). Note: For company-specific EDINET Going Concern [GC] notes and amended XBRL numeric before/after diffs, use query_jp_corporate_reputation_and_sanctions with mode="edinet_gc_amendments" instead.

keyword.description: Filer name, disclosure title, statute, or committee keyword filter.

limit.description: Maximum disclosure/macro records to return (1 to 150).

tools.name: query_jp_patents_and_saas_pricing_delta
tools.description: Query Japan Patent Office (JPO API v1) corporate patent filings/examination status and SHA-256 time-series deltas for Japanese SaaS/enterprise B2A Readiness Tiers, pricing pages, ToS, and release PDFs. Note: For OpenAlex/PubMed academic R&D papers and citations, use query_jp_academic_papers_and_patents instead.

feedType.description: Feed filter: "jpo_patents" (JPO API v1 filings), "saas_b2a_pricing_delta" (SaaS pricing/ToS/B2A diffs), "enterprise_b2a_watch", or "all".

keyword.description: Patent title, applicant, SaaS company, or domain keyword filter.

limit.description: Maximum patent/SaaS delta records to return (1 to 200).

tools.name: query_jp_wholesale_and_plateau_geospatial
tools.description: Query Toyosu/Ota wholesale produce & seafood market prices, e-Stat housing/labor series, nationwide MLIT PLATEAU 3D urban/G-Space catalogs across all 47 prefectures, and solar/seismic environment metrics (feedType). Note: For station/coordinate-centered POI and elevation search, use query_jp_area_poi_and_seismic_hazard instead.

keyword.description: Commodity, statistical table, municipality, or dataset keyword filter.

limit.description: Maximum real-economy/geospatial records to return (1 to 200).

tools.name: query_ansr_golf_ev_and_course_strategy
tools.description: Calculate 157,480-point golf Expected Value (mode="ev"), Strokes Gained ("sg"), target-EV distance ("strategy"), ShotCircle dispersion ("dispersion"), and GPS search/GamePlan across 2,005 courses (41,812 holes) in all 47 prefectures ("course_search" | "hole_strategy"). Note: For general civil POI search, use query_jp_area_poi_and_seismic_hazard instead.

mode.description: Calculation mode: "ev" (Shot/Putt Expected Value & lie penalties), "sg" (Strokes Gained between start and end states), "dispersion" (ShotCircle landing dispersion ellipse & 8-level benchmarks), "strategy" (Target EV reverse distance lookup), "course_search" (Search 2,005 Japanese golf facilities / 4,647 courses / 41,812 valid holes [raw 41,825 rows; 13 anomalous rows quarantined] GPS data), or "hole_strategy" (Hole-by-hole GPS GamePlan, SG=0 landing coordinates & tee/approach dispersion for a real course).

skillLevel.description: Optional preset skill level name or code: "World Ranker" (W↑: 68/300y), "National Ranker" (G↑: 70/270y), "Professional" (N↑: 72/270y), "Scratch" (0-: 75/250y), "Under 5" (5↓: 78/250y), "Single" (S↓: 81/230y), "80s" (8↓: 89/200y), "90s" (9↓: 98/200y).

coreScore.description: Player benchmark score (64 to 125). Overrides skillLevel if specified.

drivingDistance.description: Player average driver distance in yards (rounded to nearest 10-yard band between 180 and 330).

start.description: [Mode "sg"] Starting state before the shot: { distance, unit, lie }.

end.description: [Mode "sg"] Ending state after the shot: { distance, unit, lie } (use lie="hole_out" or distance=0 when holed).

penalty.description: [Mode "sg"] Penalty strokes incurred on the shot (default 0).

isObRetee.description: [Mode "sg"] True if the shot went Out-of-Bounds (OB) requiring a re-tee (SG = -2.0).

targetEV.description: [Mode "strategy"] Target Expected Value (strokes to hole out, e.g. 3.0) to reverse-solve for required remaining fairway distance.

currentDistanceYards.description: [Mode "strategy"] Optional current distance to the hole in yards to compute required advance yardage.

query.description: [Mode "course_search" | "hole_strategy"] Golf facility name, kana, or English substring (e.g. "ヒバリゴルフクラブ", "Hibari", "ゴールド札幌").

facilityName.description: [Mode "course_search" | "hole_strategy"] Golf facility name filter (e.g. "ヒバリゴルフクラブ").

holeNumber.description: [Mode "hole_strategy"] Specific hole number (1-18). Omit to compute the full GamePlan for all holes in the course.

state.description: [Mode "course_search"] Nationwide prefecture filter across all 47 Japanese prefectures (e.g. "北海道", "東京都", "大阪府", "兵庫県", "沖縄県").

includeHoles.description: [Mode "course_search"] Include hole-by-hole GPS coordinates and yardages.

queries.description: Optional batch of up to 10 queries in a single request.

tools.name: query_jp_area_poi_and_seismic_hazard
tools.description: Query GSI 1m elevation, J-SHIS seismic hazard, and nearby hospitals, corporations, foreclosures, and PLATEAU 3D/GTFS transit data by distance from any station, address, or lat/lon across all 47 prefectures. Note: For hospital master lookup use query_jp_medical_facilities; for foreclosure details use query_jp_court_foreclosures instead.

areaOrStation.description: Japanese address, municipality, or railway station across any of all 47 prefectures (e.g. "東京都千代田区丸の内", "札幌駅", "大阪市北区", "博多駅").
areaOrStation.default: 東京都千代田区丸の内

radiusKm.description: Haversine search radius in kilometers for nearby facilities (default: 10 km).

keyword.description: Optional keyword filter across facilities, corporations, and datasets.

limit.description: Maximum spatial POI records to return (1 to 200).

tools.name: query_jp_tcg_collectibles_market
tools.description: Query secondary-market floor prices (JPY/USD/EUR), cross-venue spread %, 7d/30d price velocity, and official Japanese set catalogs (game: all, pokemon, mtg_jp, yugioh, jp_sets) for Pokemon TCG, Japanese Foil MTG, and Yu-Gi-Oh!. Note: For general search demand trends, use query_google_search_trends instead.

keyword.description: Optional card name, set name, or SKU keyword filter.

limit.description: Maximum TCG floor-price/set records to return (1 to 200).

tools.name: query_jp_academic_papers_and_patents
tools.description: Cross-query high-citation Japanese institutional papers (OpenAlex CC0), NIH PubMed biomedical/drug-discovery metadata, and JPO R&D patent citations (feedType: all, openalex_papers, pubmed_biotech, jpo_patents). Note: For SaaS pricing/ToS B2A deltas, use query_jp_patents_and_saas_pricing_delta instead.

keyword.description: Optional topic, university, corporation, or DOI/patent keyword filter.

limit.description: Maximum academic R&D/patent citation records to return (1 to 200).

tools.name: query_jp_corporate_reputation_and_sanctions
tools.description: Query 5,858,407 Japanese corporations across all 47 prefectures (prefectureCode "01".."47") & 44,293 domains: NTA invoices, address density, Unified Qualification 62,630 corps (mode="gov_qualification"), GLEIF LEI 4,357 corps ("gleif_lei"), EDINET GC/XBRL diffs ("edinet_gc_amendments"), Kanpo 14,053 notices, and OFAC 26,364 sanctions ("ofac_sanctions") via "lookup", "screen", or 1,000-item "batch". Note: For daily incorporation/recall feeds, use query_jp_registry_and_recalls_delta instead.

mode.description: Query mode: "lookup" / "batch" for O(1) 13-digit corporate number or domain batch lookup (1 to 1,000), "screen" / "filter" for multi-condition corporate substance & co-located address density filtering across all 47 prefectures, "gleif_lei" for ISO 17442 LEI / English corporate name / BIC / LAPSED lookup across 4,357 Japanese LEI corporations, "ofac_sanctions" for Zero-PII U.S. Treasury OFAC organizational sanctions screening (26,364 organizational records; Individual scope out_of_scope), "gov_qualification" for Digital Agency Unified Government Qualification (全省庁統一資格, Government of Japan Standard Terms of Use v2.0) A–D grade & company scale lookup across 62,630 indexed corporations in all 47 prefectures (partial catalog: 0 unresolved >500-hit slices, 13 pagination pages truncated by non-JCN rows — unindexed JCNs return not_observed), or "edinet_gc_amendments" for rolling-75d FSA EDINET API v2 Going Concern notes & amended securities report XBRL numeric diffs (3,061 filings).

qualificationGrade.description: In "gov_qualification" mode, exact statutory procurement qualification grade ("A", "B", "C", or "D").

minQualificationGrade.description: Minimum statutory procurement qualification grade ("A" highest through "D") in "gov_qualification" or "screen" mode.

companyScale.description: In "gov_qualification" mode, statutory company scale ("large" 大企業, "sme" 中小企業, "micro" 小規模企業, or "other" その他).

edinetCode.description: In "edinet_gc_amendments" mode, 6-character FSA EDINET submitter code (e.g. "E02144").

secCode.description: In "edinet_gc_amendments" mode, 4- or 5-character Japanese securities code (e.g. "7203" or "72030").

docId.description: In "edinet_gc_amendments" mode, 8-character EDINET filing document ID (e.g. "S100ABCD").

goingConcernOnly.description: In "edinet_gc_amendments" mode, when true returns only corporate filings with statutory Going Concern notes (継続企業の前提に関する注記), Going Concern material events (重要事象等), or auditor Going Concern emphasis.

amendmentsOnly.description: In "edinet_gc_amendments" mode, when true returns only amended securities/quarterly/semi-annual reports (訂正報告書) with XBRL before/after element diff metadata.

excludeGoingConcern.description: In "screen" / "filter" mode, when true excludes corporations with active EDINET Going Concern notes or Going Concern material events.

excludeRecentEdinetAmendments.description: In "screen" / "filter" mode, when true excludes corporations that filed recent amended securities reports on EDINET.

lei.description: 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier (e.g. "5493006W3QUS5LMH6R84" for Toyota Motor Corporation).

leis.description: Batch of 1 to 1,000 20-character ISO 17442 LEI codes.

walletAddress.description: Crypto wallet address (EVM/Base/ETH 0x..., BTC, SOL, TRX, etc.) for OFAC SDN Digital Currency Address sanctions screening.

walletAddresses.description: Batch of 1 to 1,000 crypto wallet addresses for pre-settlement OFAC sanctions screening.

entityName.description: Organization or corporate legal name for Zero-PII OFAC SDN Entity sanctions screening.

entityNames.description: Batch of 1 to 1,000 organization names for Zero-PII OFAC SDN Entity sanctions screening.

assetSymbol.description: In "ofac_sanctions" catalog browse mode (when walletAddress/entityName are omitted), optional digital currency ticker filter across 600 organization-linked SDN wallets (e.g. "TRX", "ETH", "XBT", "USDT", "ARB", "BCH", "XMR", "SOL").

includeWeakAliases.description: In "ofac_sanctions" mode, controls whether U.S. Treasury OFAC <category>weak</category> organizational AKAs (2,160 aliases) are included. Defaults to false (matches primary names + 11,549 strong AKAs only). When true, weak AKAs are also matched and tagged with matchedVia="weak_aka_alias" and akaStrength="weak".

strictExcludeUnobserved.description: In "screen" / "filter" mode, controls unknown/unobserved handling for exclusion filters (excludeGoingConcern, excludeRecentEdinetAmendments, excludeLapsedLei). When false (default), unobserved corporations (e.g. not_observed_in_window for 75d EDINET or no registered LEI) are retained with explicit unobservedOrExcludedScopes[] tags (never certified clean). When true, unobserved corporations are ALSO excluded.

lapsedOnly.description: In "gleif_lei" mode, when true returns only Japanese corporations whose LEI annual renewal status is LAPSED.

hasBicOnly.description: In "gleif_lei" mode, when true returns only Japanese corporations with registered SWIFT BIC codes.

requireGleifLei.description: In "screen" / "filter" mode, when true requires the corporation to hold an active or registered GLEIF LEI.

excludeLapsedLei.description: In "screen" / "filter" mode, when true excludes corporations whose GLEIF LEI status is LAPSED.

corporateNumber.description: 13-digit Japanese Corporate Number with valid NTA Mod-9 check digit (e.g. "6010001269339", "3120001079845") across 5,858,407 registered corporations in all 10,000 R2 shards (generation gen_37500fcdaacecf05).

corporateNumbers.description: Batch of 1 to 1,000 13-digit Japanese Corporate Numbers.

domain.description: Filter or reverse-lookup by normalized official corporate website host (e.g. "andque.com", "smarthr.jp") across 107,126 D1 directory corporations / 44,227 unique corporate domains (4,551 live-measured B2A Readiness Tier & SPF/DMARC corporations).

domains.description: Batch of 1 to 1,000 corporate domains for counterparty batch verification.

prefectureCode.description: 2-digit JIS prefecture code ("01" to "47", e.g. "13" for Tokyo, "27" for Osaka).

prefecture.description: Prefecture name or code (e.g. "東京都", "大阪府", "13").

maxAddressDensity.description: Maximum number of active corporations registered at the same normalized building address (e.g. 49 or 50 to exclude high-density co-located addresses).

excludeHighDensity50Plus.description: When true, excludes corporations registered at addresses with 50 or more co-located active corporations.

requireInvoiceRegistered.description: When true, requires active NTA Qualified Invoice Issuer registration without revocation or expiration.

requireRealBusinessSignal.description: When true, requires at least one verified public activity signal (government procurement award, subsidy approval, patent/trademark, permit certification, financial disclosure, or official corporate domain).

excludeParrySpamObserved.description: When true, excludes entities with observed PARRY unsolicited outbound domain/telephone matches, published administrative sanction records, or revoked/expired invoice registration.

maxNameChangeCount.description: Maximum historical corporate name change count.

keyword.description: Optional substring filter across corporate name, municipality, or domain.

limit.description: Maximum corporate/sanctions records to return per call (1 to 1,000).
